title: A one-week dry run of an owner-built split before the first test
decision_task: Is the owner's split mechanism trustworthy before the first real test?
business_types: any business running its first manual split
applies_when: first owner-built split (two email lists, alternating landing pages, staff assigning leads)
exclusions: platform-native split tools with proven assignment and exposed counts (still run the SRM check)
required_inputs: the same tracking in both arms
evidence_requirements: one week of both arms identical
missing_data_behavior: Rare events: judge the dry run on the split and event parity, not on a p-value.
alternatives_when_constrained: no instrumentation: fix tracking first (diagnostics 'tracking' verdict)

decision_branches.then: Skip the dry run; still run the split check.

decision_branches.if: Owner-built split (two lists, alternating pages, staff assignment)
decision_branches.then: 7-day dry run: identical arms, pass = split check + same events logged in both.

implementation_steps: Run both arms identical for 7 days
Every event type appears in both arms; no unit in both arms
Do not judge conversion p-values: rare events give few possible outcomes
If unit-level history exists (e.g. an email list with past opens), ClimbOS can re-randomize it offline about 100 times in code and check that about 5% fall below 0.05
dependencies: A way to assign and count arms
guardrails: no customer-visible difference during the dry run
stop_conditions: SRM warn or missing events: fix before any real test
review_triggers: Owner corrects an input this playbook relies on
A metric or guardrail crosses its bound
The underlying source or platform rule changes

interpretation: INTERPRETATION: ExP's A/A is a statistical calibration on large logs; at small scale, its trust-check purpose (assignment and telemetry parity) transfers, its p-value calibration mostly does not.
proposed_climbos_rule: PROPOSED RULE: recommend a 7-day dry run before an owner's first manual split; pass = SRM pass + event parity.
disagreements: None; ExP adds the rare-event caution (EXP-06-F3) that BK06 review does not mention.

hypothetical_evaluation_cases.label: hypothetical
expected_behavior: form_start missing in treatment: dry run fails on event parity
hard_failure: passes the dry run because SRM passed
reports an A/A conversion p-value as proof the system works

notes: Proposed reference contract. Not executable; does not authorize publishing, sending or spending. Numbers in source references are dated author figures, never forecasts.
